title: How Toxic Can You Get? Search-based Toxicity Testing for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Using a search-based testing framework (EvoTox) to generate prompt mutants conditioned on eliciting 'racist' responses, and scoring the toxicity of the language model's outputs using the Perspective API.

Using a search-based testing framework (EvoTox) to generate prompt mutants conditioned on eliciting 'homophobic' responses, and scoring the toxicity of the language model's outputs using the Perspective API.

Using a search-based testing framework (EvoTox) to generate prompt mutants conditioned on eliciting 'sexist' responses, and scoring the toxicity of the language model's outputs using the Perspective API.
